thread:
chris: escalating from support — BigRetail reported 502s from /v1/rerank when inputs contain weird bytes (escape sequences like \x1b, embedded nulls, and emoji clusters). Logs show 'invalid utf8' and occasionally extreme negative scores.

maya: @chris can you paste the raw payload they used? any repro cURL?

bigretail_rep: sharing a sanitized sample here, can DM raw if needed:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"Price\x00 drop 🎉","candidates":["Cheap\x1b[31m item","Discount 😊"]}'

chris: thanks. Repro in our logs shows runtime threw UnicodeDecodeError and worker restarted: 
```
runtime.decode_input() -> UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x1b
```
This correlates with 502s and a few noisy regressions in score distribution.

juan: :eyes: adding eng-runtime. Looks like request sanitizer missed control chars. That can also misalign KV cache offsets and lead to bogus scores.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-129, 502 spike 13:40-13:56 UTC, affected ~0.7% of rerank requests.

carla: repro steps (node):
```
const payload = { query: "Price\u0000 drop 🎉", candidates: ["Cheap\u001b[31m item", "Discount 😊"] };
await client.rerank(payload);
```
Response: 502, body: {"error":"invalid utf8 in request body"} (runtime returned non-JSON on crash).

maya: short-term workaround: client-side sanitize with normalize('NFC') + strip C0/C1 control chars (except \n/\t). Or base64-encode text fields and mark content-type application/base64+json.

juan: long-term we should harden the server: strict UTF-8 validation at edge, then graceful replacement of control chars (U+FFFD) and metric for dropped bytes. Also avoid restarting worker on decode exceptions.

chris: customer also reports when null byte present top candidate score becomes -inf. Is that from fallback scoring?

carla: yes — current fallback emits -9999 which gets mapped to -inf in downstream normalization. I'll change fallback to NaN and filter candidates instead of emitting extreme negatives.

juan: drafting PR redwood/runtime#1824 to add sanitizer + graceful decode + telemetry. Running unit tests now.

maya: can we hotfix to canary tonight? customer needs ETA.

juan: if tests pass, we can push to canary this evening UTC and roll tomorrow morning. Will gate behind feature flag.

bigretail_rep: appreciate it. Please ping when canary URL is live so we can validate with their raw payloads. They also asked for a logging artifact for the failed requests.

carla: will add structured logs including hex dump of offending bytes (scrubbed) and a trace id for each drop.

chris: :white_check_mark: thanks team — I'll update the customer and keep this thread for verification notes.
